title: Impl: C/Zephyr fatal error handler with key state dump
description: Register k_sys_fatal_error_handler in lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/ that dumps key scalars via LOG_ERR before halt: TX queue depth (tx_queue_count()), replay counter, routing table entry count, modem state (tx_pending atomic), last RX size. Use printk if LOG is unavailable at fault time. Gate behind CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG_FATAL_DUMP (new Kconfig bool, default y). Verify: build compiles.
